name: anun333/oe-module-layout-export
description: Export OpenEMR's layout forms and lists to files you can keep in version control, compare a file with a site or with another file, and read the SQL files the old backup.php page wrote, without running them

footprint-not-covered: Whether the permission check above behaves correctly for a user without `admin / super`. The end-to-end check refuses a clinician the page and the download; the README's "Who can open what" section describes it.

Whether exports and compares are right. The unit tests in `tests/` cover the file readers, the export format and the compare; the end-to-end check against a running OpenEMR is described in the README.
